questions.question: The value of M in ((p)/(q))²M⁺² = ((q)/(p))⁹⁻M
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The equation is:

(p/q)²M⁺² = (q/p)⁹⁻M

**Formula used:**

Using the property of exponents:

am × aⁿ = am⁺ⁿ and a⁻ⁿ = 1/aⁿ

**Calculation:**

(p/q)²M⁺² = (q/p)⁹⁻M

⇒ (p/q)²M⁺² = (p/q)⁻⁽⁹⁻M⁾

⇒ 2M + 2 = -(9 - M)

⇒ 2M + 2 = -9 + M

⇒ 2M - M = -9 - 2

⇒ M = -11

**∴ The value of M is -11.**

Find the value of n, when 3⁻⁷ times 3⁽³ⁿ⁺⁴⁾ = frac{3¹¹}{3⁵}
questions.solution:
**Given:**

3⁻⁷ × 3⁽³ⁿ⁺⁴⁾ = 3¹¹ / 3⁵

**Formula Used:**

am × aⁿ = am⁺ⁿ

am / aⁿ = am⁻ⁿ

If am = aⁿ, then m = n.

**Calculation:**

LHS: 3⁻⁷ × 3⁽³ⁿ⁺⁴⁾ = 3⁽⁻⁷⁾ ⁺ ⁽³ⁿ⁺⁴⁾

3⁻⁷ ⁺ ³ⁿ ⁺ ⁴ = 3⁽³ⁿ ⁻ ³⁾

RHS: 3¹¹ / 3⁵ = 3⁽¹¹ ⁻ ⁵⁾

3¹¹ / 3⁵ = 3⁶

Now, 3⁽³ⁿ ⁻ ³⁾ = 3⁶

Since the bases are equal, the exponents must be equal:

3n - 3 = 6

3n = 6 + 3

3n = 9

n = 3

**The value of n is 3.**
